description: For our Facebook Live event, we were joined by community advocates, labor leaders, musicians and elected officials including — Senators Mona Das, Jeannie Darneille, and Claire Wilson, Speaker Laurie Jinkins, Our program featured Dr. Jennifer Jones, Makela Steward, Erin Jones, and labor leaders Cherika Carter, April Sims and Shaunie Wheeler James. Thank you to our host committee: Lem Howell, Nate Miles, Lauren Parris Watts, Melissa Taylor, Hon. J. Wesley Saint Claire (ret.), Redmond City Councilm
